role: VitalsHealthQueries extension: HealthKit reads for overnight recovery vitals (respiratory rate + 7-day baseline, SpO2 avg/min, wrist temperature + baseline, resting HR with min-HR fallback), the anchored-query vitals observers that bump vitalsDataVersion, and daily step/distance/flight totals; plus HealthKitManager.DailyActivity.
types: HealthKitManager.DailyActivity: struct (Identifiable, Equatable, Sendable) — one day's steps/distance/flights
toplevel: Nested struct DailyActivity declared in an extension of HealthKitManager (lines 507-515). All other code in units.

flags.text: Comment says the respiratory window is '24-hour window centered around the reference date's overnight period', but vitalsWindow is a trailing 24 h window ending at min(referenceDate, now).

units.does: Concurrently fetches respiratory rate, its baseline, SpO2 avg and min, wrist temperature and its baseline, and resting HR for the window ending at referenceDate, and returns them as a RecoveryVitals.
Reads up to the 10 most recent respiratory-rate samples in the trailing 24 h window and returns their mean in breaths/min, bounded by the vitals query timeout.

branches.cond: HealthKit unavailable or respiratoryRate type nil

flags.text: Mean of only the 10 newest samples in a 24 h window (limit: 10, sorted by end date desc), not the whole night; a night with more than 10 samples is represented by its last part only.

units.does: Predicate for samples starting in [windowEnd − hours, windowEnd] where windowEnd = min(referenceDate, now), strictStartDate.
Predicate for samples starting in the `days` days before (min(referenceDate, now) − 24 h), strictStartDate.
True when referenceDate is in today (Calendar.current).
Converts query result to mean breaths/min; logs and returns nil on error or no samples.

branches.cond: samples not HKQuantitySample array or empty
branches.effect: logs 'No respiratory rate samples', returns nil; otherwise mean

units.does: Respiratory baseline: discreteAverage over the 7 days before tonight's window; on success writes RespiratoryBaselineCache when referenceDate is today; when HK unavailable or the query yields nil, returns the cached value (≤30 days old).

flags.text: For a historical referenceDate (reanalysis of an older night) a nil HealthKit result falls back to the cache holding TODAY's baseline, so the old night is scored against a baseline from a different week; the write side is date-guarded (line 113) but the read side at line 116 is not.

units.does: Converts statistics to average breaths/min; logs and returns nil on error or no data.

branches.effect: logs 'No respiratory baseline data', returns nil; otherwise value

units.does: Average SpO2 (percent) over the trailing 24 h window via discreteAverage statistics.
Minimum SpO2 (percent) over the trailing 24 h window via discreteMin statistics.
Converts an SpO2 quantity (fraction) to percent ×100; on error logs via logSpO2Error and returns nil; on missing quantity optionally logs and returns nil.

branches.effect: logs 'No SpO2 data found'; otherwise silent

units.does: Logs an SpO2 query error at warning level unless it is HKError.errorNoData.
Most recent appleSleepingWristTemperature sample in the trailing 24 h window, normalised by wristTemperatureDeviation (iOS 16+).

branches.cond: HealthKit unavailable, iOS < 16, or type nil

units.does: Takes the first sample's °C value, normalises it; logs and returns nil on error, no sample, or out-of-range value.

branches.effect: logs 'out of expected range'; returns nil

units.does: Returns temp unchanged if within [-5,5] °C, temp − 36.5 if within [30,42] °C, else nil.

branches.effect: returns temp (treated as already a deviation)

units.does: Wrist temperature baseline: mean normalised deviation of all samples in the 7 days before tonight's window; writes WristTemperatureBaselineCache when referenceDate is today; falls back to the cache when HK unavailable or nil.

branches.cond: HealthKit unavailable, iOS < 16, or type nil

flags.text: Same as the respiratory baseline: a historical reanalysis whose HealthKit query yields nil is given today's cached wrist-temperature baseline (read at line 265 is not date-guarded), so isTemperatureElevated for that past night compares against the wrong week.

units.does: Averages the normalised deviations of the samples; nil on error, no samples, or no sample surviving normalisation.

branches.cond: samples not quantity samples or empty

units.does: Stops existing vitals observers, then starts an anchored observer query (with immediate background delivery) for each observed vitals type.
Returns quantity types respiratoryRate, oxygenSaturation, restingHeartRate, and on iOS 16+ appleSleepingWristTemperature, each only if HealthKit returns the type.

Creates an HKAnchoredObjectQuery over the last 48 h for the type, ignores initial results, and on each update with new samples increments manager.vitalsDataVersion on the main actor; stores, executes the query and enables immediate background delivery (completion ignored).

branches.cond: manager deallocated or update has no new samples
branches.effect: handler does nothing; otherwise bumps vitalsDataVersion

flags.text: enableBackgroundDelivery's completion (success, error) is discarded, so a failure to register background delivery is never logged.

The vitals observer's only effect is bumping HealthKitManager.vitalsDataVersion, which RRCollector+Bindings mirrors into MorningCoordination.vitalsDataVersion; nothing in the repo reads either (grep: only the declarations, the mirror and this increment). The comments promise views re-fetch and re-archive the vitals snapshot when late Watch vitals land, so that never happens through this path, while immediate background delivery keeps waking the app for 4 types.

units.does: Stops every stored vitals observer query and clears the list.

flags.text: Only caller is startObservingVitalsData (line 296); nothing outside stops the observers, and background delivery enabled at line 333 is never disabled.

units.does: Resting HR for the 36 h window ending at min(referenceDate, now), excluding this app's own HR/RHR writes: Apple's newest .restingHeartRate sample, else the minimum .heartRate in the window.

branches.effect: returns it; otherwise logs and falls back to minimum heart rate

flags.text: Fallback uses the lowest instantaneous heart-rate sample over 36 h as 'resting heart rate'; the doc comment on minimumHeartRate calls it a 24h-window minimum though the predicate is 36 h.

units.does: Newest .restingHeartRate sample's bpm matching the predicate (limit 1, end-date desc).
Returns first sample's value in the given unit; logs and returns nil on error.

branches.effect: logs, returns nil; otherwise first sample's value or nil

units.does: Minimum heart rate (bpm) matching the predicate via discreteMin statistics.
Returns the minimum quantity in the unit; logs and returns nil on error.
Returns per-day activity (steps, distance, flights) for today and the previous days−1 days, most recent first; today's window ends now.
Concurrently sums steps, distance and flights for the day window and returns a DailyActivity.
Steps between start and end summed across all sources, as Int; 0 when unavailable, empty range, or no data.

flags.text: Every failure (HealthKit locked/denied, query error swallowed in sumActivityQuery, timeout) collapses to 0, indistinguishable from a real zero steps; the Fitness pill/daily activity then shows 0 instead of 'no data'.

units.does: Walking/running distance in meters between start and end; 0 when unavailable or no data.

flags.text: Every failure (HealthKit locked/denied, query error swallowed in sumActivityQuery, timeout) collapses to 0, indistinguishable from a real zero meters; the Fitness pill/daily activity then shows 0 instead of 'no data'.

units.does: Flights climbed between start and end; 0 when unavailable or no data.

flags.text: Every failure (HealthKit locked/denied, query error swallowed in sumActivityQuery, timeout) collapses to 0, indistinguishable from a real zero flights; the Fitness pill/daily activity then shows 0 instead of 'no data'.

units.does: cumulativeSum HKStatisticsQuery over [start,end] (strictStartDate) returning the sum in unit or nil; the query error is ignored.
Identifiable id = date.
